subject: Renewal: NewCo - Conditional rate guard & commit swap
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@newco.com>, Sophie Zhang <sophie.zhang@newco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal proposal & optional commit uplift - NewCo

Hi Tom / Sophie,

Thanks for the time on Tuesday. Attached is a compact renewal proposal built to keep your unit economics predictable as you scale through next year. Short summary:

- Base rate: $0.012 / token (current list $0.015)
- Conditional rate guard: hold base rate for 6 months from renewal effective date if NewCo signs the 12-month commitment
- Commitment swap option: convert up to 20% of current committed units into a 12-month reserved tranche at a 12% discount to the base rate
- Burst capacity: 2x burst pool available at list with prioritized capacity during peak windows

I included a one-page term sheet (NewCo_Renewal_TermSheet_v3.pdf) and the usage extract we ran. Can you confirm whether procurement needs a 6- or 12-month price hold? Also please confirm the internal billing cadence (Net30 vs Net45) so we can align the order form.

Next steps I suggest:
1) You confirm price-hold duration and any internal PO timing constraints;
2) If you want the commit swap, confirm target uplift percentage (we recommended 20%);
3) I’ll loop in finance/legal to finalize the order form and get a DocuSign out.

If helpful, happy to do a 15-min call tomorrow morning to walk the table.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0127

Attachments: NewCo_Renewal_TermSheet_v3.pdf (pdf), usage-history-2026.csv (csv)

From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@newco.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Zhang <sophie.zhang@newco.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal & optional commit uplift - NewCo

Neha — thanks for the clear layout. A few quick items from procurement:

- We need at least a 6-month price hold on the base rate; 12 months would be ideal but may require an internal approval path.
- The commit swap is interesting; can you confirm implementation timing? We can commit to a 15–25% uplift but need the uplift to kick in at the renewal effective date.
- Billing: we typically do Net45 for renewals; can you confirm Redwood is fine with Net45?

Also: Sophie is handling legal review — looping her in so we can get any redlines quickly. If you can give a straight yes/no on a 12-month hold (today) that helps us decide whether to escalate internally.

Thanks,
Tom Ellis
Head of Platform, NewCo Inc.
Tom.Ellis@newco.com | +1 212-555-3378

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T14:30:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal proposal & optional commit uplift - NewCo (procurement asks)

Marissa, Ben — forwarding Tom's note. Procurement is asking for

- a 6-month price hold (would prefer 12),
- commit swap of ~20% effective at renewal, and
- Net45 billing.

Proposal I want to surface for approval:
- Offer 12% discount off our proposed base if NewCo ups commit by >=20% for a 12-month reserved tranche.
- Provide a guaranteed 6-month price hold on base list; if Marissa signs off, we can extend to 12 months conditional on the 20% uplift being contracted at signature.
- Keep burst pool at list but grant preemptive allocation window for first 30 days after renewal.

Can we get a quick go/no-go from Finance and Sales Ops? If you want I can draft the exact order-form language and push to DocuSign.

Quote from Tom below for context:

> We need at least a 6-month price hold on the base rate; 12 months would be ideal but may require an internal approval path.
> The commit swap is interesting; can you confirm implementation timing?
> Billing: we typically do Net45 for renewals; can you confirm Redwood is fine with Net45?

Thanks — Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal proposal & optional commit uplift - NewCo (procurement asks)

Neha — quick response after reviewing usage and risk:

Approved with conditions. Summary:

- Approve a 6-month mandatory price hold on the base rate.
- Approve 12-month price hold only if NewCo signs the 12-month reserved tranche at >=20% uplift (we'll model the net ARR impact before final).
- Approve the 12% renewal discount on the reserved tranche tied to the 20% uplift commitment.
- Net45 is acceptable for this customer given relationship and case for retention; Finance signs off but requires the order form to include an invoice schedule and late fee terms.

Operational notes:
- Add a clause that the rate hold only applies to base usage under the committed SKU; excess/burst usage billed at list and not subject to historic rate guard.
- Legal: I'll have Counsel review the term-sheet redline for the conditional 12-month hold. If legal flags anything, I'll loop in Pete.

Neha — please move forward to a DocuSign with: term sheet + order form + invoice schedule. Make sure to attach the usage extract and highlight the uplift calculation in the order form (line item).

Marissa
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

(Quick note: if NewCo requests an earlier effective date for the reserved tranche, flag to me; may need pro-rata amortization.)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@newco.com>, Sophie Zhang <sophie.zhang@newco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T15:47:00-08:00
Subject: Final terms & DocuSign - NewCo renewal (summary + next steps)

Tom / Sophie — following internal approvals, attaching the finalized term sheet and the order form for signature. Short summary of agreed terms:

- Base rate: $0.012 / token (as proposed)
- Price hold: 6-month guaranteed price hold on base rate starting at renewal effective date
- Conditional extension: extend to 12 months if NewCo signs a 12-month reserved tranche with >=20% uplift at signature; reserved tranche receives 12% discount to base rate
- Burst capacity: available at list price; 30-day prioritized allocation window post-renewal for committed customers
- Billing: Net45 (Finance has approved; order form includes invoice schedule and late fees)

Attachments: NewCo_Renewal_TermSheet_v3.pdf (pdf) — this includes the order form and uplift calculation.

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8743) | DocuSign (https://www.docusign.com/link/NC-RNW-8743)

Please review and sign the DocuSign by EOD Friday so we can lock capacity for your Q1 migration window. Once signed we’ll schedule a short ops kickoff to map the reserved tranche provisioning and SLOs.

Thanks again — happy to jump on a 15-min call if you want to walk any clause.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
